baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic possession construction إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا coordinates أَنكَالًا with جَحِيمًا as items held together.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first item checks bodily movement while the second turns the surrounding medium into severe heat. The pair therefore forms a controlled enclosure: the subject is immobilized locally and denied habitable space globally.

activation_trace.role: The restraining shackle or check supplies literal immobilization and serves as the body's external movement-blocker.
Blazing fire and severe heat supply the literal surrounding hazard and close the captive's remaining space.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists two independent punishments kept by God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a coordinated custody system: a check on the body inside an environment that itself prevents escape.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنكَالًا can activate the ن ك ل branch of punishment that deters both its recipient and observers, while جَحِيمًا supplies the severe consequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sanction is communicative as well as painful. A visibly severe consequence stops recurrence in the punished party and projects a warning outward to a social audience.

activation_trace.role: Exemplary deterrent punishment supplies the social warning function and makes the punished case restrain others too.
The blaze supplies the unmistakably severe consequence that gives the exemplary warning its force.

changed_reading.before: The threat concerns only what happens to its direct recipient.
changed_reading.after: The threatened treatment also functions as a public deterrent whose reach exceeds the body undergoing it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of أَنكَالًا also carries a branch of shrinking back from a demand through fear, weakness, or refusal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the concrete shackle sense, the stored blaze can be read as an aversive field that makes an approaching subject recoil. Restraint then begins before contact as a collapse of forward willingness.

activation_trace.role: Shrinking back from a demand supplies the inward recoil and functions as a psychological form of checked advance.
Intense blazing heat supplies the aversive object before which advance collapses.

changed_reading.before: أَنكَالًا names only hardware applied after capture.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the threat also names induced recoil: the blaze checks approach before the shackles check limbs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَحِيمًا is anchored in a root inventory that includes the face flaring with anger, coordinated with exemplary أَنكَالًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The blaze may carry an affective overtone in which anger becomes externally administered deterrent treatment. This is a tonal overlay on the fire sense, not a replacement for it.

activation_trace.role: The face flaring with anger supplies an affective heat image and colors the blaze as sanction made emotionally legible.
Exemplary punishment converts the affective flare into an outward deterrent consequence.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is a purely impersonal thermal object.
changed_reading.after: The blaze can carry a contained overtone of flaring anger embodied in an exemplary sanction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement passes from being wrapped or burdened, through standing under a heavy word, to restraining one's own panic. Against that sequence, أَنكَالًا becomes the negative counterpart of disciplined weight: chosen constraint trains agency, whereas the stored check removes agency.

activation_trace.role: The imposed shackle supplies the terminal loss of movement against which earlier chosen disciplines are contrasted.
Burden and weight supply the opening embodied load and begin the surah's mechanics of constraint.
Bodily rising supplies voluntary movement against weight and functions as retained agency.
Literal heaviness supplies the demanding load of the word and makes weight potentially formative rather than merely punitive.
Holding the self back from panic supplies self-restraint and contrasts inwardly governed checking with an external shackle.

structural_cues: The opening imperatives repeatedly require bodily and verbal discipline before the punitive inventory appears.
The sequence moves from burden to standing to a heavy word to patience, then changes grammatical subject at 73:11-12 from the addressee's action to what is held with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burden, bodily rising, heaviness, self-restraint, and an imposed check; I infer a contrast between chosen discipline that preserves agency and coercive restraint that removes it. A live alternative is that these are adjacent but independent uses of weight and restraint imagery.

changed_reading.before: The shackle is an isolated image of physical punishment.
changed_reading.after: The shackle is also the coercive inverse of the surah's earlier voluntary disciplines: refusal of self-governed weight ends in externally governed immobility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to leave the deniers to the speaker and grant an unhurried interval is followed immediately by the assertion that the restraints and blaze are with that same speaker. Divine possession therefore reads as controlled withholding: the means are already available although enforcement is delayed.

activation_trace.role: The restraining instrument supplies the concrete means already held in reserve.
The blaze supplies the second reserved means and makes the delayed consequence materially complete.
Leaving or letting be supplies the temporary nonintervention and transfers handling of the deniers to the first-person speaker.
Unhurried deliberateness supplies the interval and functions as postponement rather than lack of capacity.

structural_cues: 73:11 and 73:12 are joined by an immediate shift from وَذَرْنِي and وَمَهِّلْهُمْ to emphatic إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا.
The first-person object in ذَرْنِي and first-person possessive in لَدَيْنَا keep agency with the same speaker across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies letting be, deliberate delay, and an already possessed punitive inventory; I infer that the delay is a controlled interval before enforcement. The alternative is a rhetorical juxtaposition that makes no claim about an enforcement schedule.

changed_reading.before: لَدَيْنَا merely states where punishments are located.
changed_reading.after: لَدَيْنَا answers the preceding respite: the punishment is withheld under control, not absent or unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressees' soft living and pleasant station are reversed feature by feature. Shackles cancel ease of movement, while severe heat replaces a congenial dwelling; punishment is tailored as an inversion of enjoyed privilege rather than a generic pain list.

activation_trace.role: The restraining shackle supplies hard impediment and reverses the bodily freedom associated with ease.
Severe heat supplies an uninhabitable station and reverses the comfort of a pleasant residence.
Softness, ease, and affluent living supply the prior bodily condition that the shackles negate.
A congenial place and pleasant stay supply the prior spatial comfort that the blaze overturns.

structural_cues: أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ immediately identifies the threatened group before the two indefinite punitive nouns.
The coordination of shackles and blaze permits a bodily and environmental reversal of the preceding نعمة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies soft affluent life, pleasant station, restraints, and severe heat; I assign the reversal arrows from softness to impediment and from pleasant dwelling to hostile environment. The alternative is that نعمة only identifies social status and does not shape the punishment's form.

changed_reading.before: The two punishments are generic tokens of severity.
changed_reading.after: They form a precise reversal of elite ease: comfort of motion becomes restraint and comfort of place becomes blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah moves restraint inward. The shackle blocks limbs, choking food blocks the throat, the withholding branch of عذاب reinforces prevention, and the blaze encloses both. The list becomes a multiscale system that stops passage through body, intake, and environment.

activation_trace.role: The shackle supplies external obstruction and blocks locomotion at the scale of the limbs.
The blaze supplies environmental enclosure around the externally and internally obstructed body.
Tasting and taking in food supply the expected inward passage that the next image frustrates.
A choking obstruction in the throat supplies internal blockage and relocates the shackle mechanism inside the body.
Checking, withholding, and weaning supply a second prevention image and generalize restraint into deprivation.

structural_cues: 73:12-13 is one uninterrupted nominal list joined by repeated conjunctions.
The sequence moves spatially from external restraints and surrounding blaze to food lodged at the throat and then names painful punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a limb-check, environmental heat, intake, throat obstruction, and withholding; I infer a shared anti-passage mechanism across scales. The live alternative is an additive catalog in which each punishment operates independently.

changed_reading.before: The shackles immobilize a body located beside a fire.
changed_reading.after: The sequence closes every route of passage: limbs cannot travel, food cannot descend, and the surrounding medium cannot be inhabited.

context_deltas.mechanism: The captive is checked precisely when the normally solid world becomes mobile. Earth convulses, mountain solidity becomes a gathered sand heap, and that heap pours away. Restraint is therefore asymmetric: the body cannot move intentionally while its footing moves uncontrollably.

activation_trace.role: The shackle fixes the captive and removes intentional relocation when the substrate begins to fail.
The blaze makes the unstable scene thermally hostile, so loss of footing cannot become an escape route.
Severe convulsion supplies involuntary world-motion against the captive's imposed immobility.
A high solid mass supplies the expected stable anchor that the ayah then transforms.
Material gathered into a heap supplies mountain form after solidity has been reduced to loose accumulation.
Measured material pouring away supplies the final loss of stable footing and completes the no-escape geometry.

structural_cues: The temporal opener يَوْمَ attaches the punitive list to the convulsion scene.
Repeated الْجِبَالُ first presents mountain mass and then predicates its transformation into كَثِيبًا مَهِيلًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies imposed bodily restraint, convulsion, solid mountains, loose heaps, and pouring; I infer an asymmetric geometry in which the person is fixed while the world loses fixity. The alternative is that the cosmic scene marks scale and terror without specifying how the restraints function within it.

changed_reading.before: Shackles imply an ordinary prison with stable ground and walls.
changed_reading.after: The prison is event-like rather than architectural: the captive is fixed while the world's own anchors convulse and pour away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh analogy supplies the operational chain implicit in exemplary نكال: witnessed message, departure from obedience, culpable seizure, and a severely harmful taking. The focus threat is no longer an abstract display; it has an inspectable precedent with offense, evidence, and enforcement.

activation_trace.role: Exemplary deterrent punishment supplies the model that the subsequent historical analogy makes operational.
Presence together with seeing supplies an evidentiary witness and makes the warning answerable to observed conduct.
Departure from obedience supplies the precipitating offense in the exemplar sequence.
Seizing and captivity supply the enforcement transition from disobedience to bodily control.
Harmful severity and weight supply the quality of the seizure and connect it to the focus's punitive apparatus.

structural_cues: The explicit كَمَا comparison repeats أَرْسَلْنَا and رَسُولًا across the present audience and Pharaoh.
73:16 uses a tight فَعَصَى ... فَأَخَذْنَاهُ sequence, grammatically linking offense to seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, disobedience, capture, and harmful severity after an explicit analogy; I infer that this chain instantiates the exemplary branch of نكال. The alternative is that Pharaoh is a general warning by analogy without a procedural model of the focus punishment.

changed_reading.before: Exemplarity is only a lexical possibility inside أَنكَالًا.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding sequence activates exemplarity as a witnessed precedent: warning, refusal, seizure, and severe consequence can recur before a new audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the discourse later calls itself a reminder and immediately leaves a path to whoever wills, the exemplary threat acquires a present operation. Before future punishment restrains bodies, its recital can make hearers recoil from one course and voluntarily take another.

activation_trace.role: Exemplary punishment supplies a warning designed to restrain people beyond the eventual recipient.
Shrinking back from a demand supplies the immediate behavioral effect that the warning can produce before physical capture.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the discourse's explicit present warning function.
Will directed toward an object supplies live agency and makes redirection possible before coercive restraint.
An extended traversable path supplies the available movement that contrasts with shackled immobility.

structural_cues: The deictic هَذِهِ in إِنَّ هَذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ can gather the preceding warning sequence into a present reminder.
The immediate فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ ... سَبِيلًا construction preserves a voluntary path after the threat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exemplary sanction, recoil, a reminder, willing, and a traversable path; I infer that the warning is meant to redirect will now and thereby avert later restraint. The alternative is that هَذِهِ refers broadly to the surah and that the path clause is not specifically linked to 73:12.

changed_reading.before: The punishment becomes exemplary only after someone undergoes it.
changed_reading.after: Its verbal announcement already performs نكال: it can check a chosen trajectory while a path remains open, before any shackle is applied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence describes value cut out as a loan for return, sent ahead, later found in God's presence as recompense. That structure retroactively makes لَدَيْنَا sound like a reserve side of the same return economy: punitive items too are held ready as consequences, not random eruptions.

activation_trace.role: Exemplary punishment supplies the consequential item held in the divine reserve.
The blaze supplies the second concrete item in the reserve and prevents the model from becoming merely abstract accounting.
Cutting out wealth or work for its return supplies the transaction-and-recompense structure.
Advancing something ahead supplies temporal deposit before later encounter.
Finding and coming upon the thing supplies retrieval and confirms that what was advanced remains available.
Nearness and presence at something supply the locative echo of لَدَيْنَا and locate the return with God.
Recompense for work supplies the explicit return principle that organizes the closing sequence.

structural_cues: لَدَيْنَا in 73:12 and عِندَ اللَّهِ in 73:20 are parallel divine-proximity constructions.
73:20 orders giving, sending ahead, finding with God, comparative value, and recompense in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loan-for-return, advance deposit, later finding, divine proximity, recompense, and the focus inventory; I infer a shared reserve-and-return architecture. The materially live alternative is that the reward economy in 73:20 is independent and لَدَيْنَا in 73:12 is only a possession statement.

changed_reading.before: With Us are describes a static store of punitive objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it marks the consequence side of a return structure: what is advanced is found with God, and the focus names what is held there for the opposite trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah measures obligations, repeatedly recognizes human limits, opens ease, protects from the effect of sin, and ends in mercy. This does not remove the blaze, but it weakens the baseline possibility that flaring anger is the governing mechanism; the punitive inventory is better read as controlled disposition within calibrated judgment.

activation_trace.role: The face flaring with anger supplies the affective reading whose governing status is being tested and reduced.
Planning by measure and consideration supplies deliberate calibration rather than uncontrolled affect.
Disclosure of the situation to the knower supplies repeated awareness of actual human capacity.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies responsive accommodation and limits an anger-dominant account.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies a counter-operation to exemplary exposure and harm.
Mercy and tenderness supply the surah's final named disposition and constrain the affective-blaze branch.

structural_cues: 73:20 repeats عَلِمَ and مَا تَيَسَّرَ while reducing the demanded practice in view of inability, illness, travel, and fighting.
The surah's final predicates are غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ, after an imperative to seek forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured planning, repeated knowledge, ease, protective forgiveness, and mercy; I infer that the ending regulates how far the anger branch should control 73:12. The alternative is that mercy toward responsive hearers and fierce anger toward deniers remain deliberately separate without mutual qualification.

changed_reading.before: The blaze can be governed by an image of anger flaring outward into punishment.
changed_reading.after: The anger image may color the threat, but the full context makes controlled, measured disposition more adequate than an uncontrolled affective mechanism.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because جَحِيمًا in the coordinated punishment list strongly favors literal blaze, yet the focus inventory's glowing or staring eye branch and the later witness's presence-with-seeing keep a visual exposure overlay anchored. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary image of inescapable scrutiny, never as a replacement translation for fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَحِيمًا carries a branch image of the glowing or staring eye, while the coordinated shackle prevents withdrawal from its field.

activation_trace.role: The glowing or staring eye supplies a visual blaze and functions as an imagistic field of scrutiny.
The shackle supplies immobilization and makes the subject unable to evade the imagined gaze.
Presence with seeing supplies witnessed exposure and activates the eye branch as more than free association.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is only a thermal environment.
changed_reading.after: As a contained overlay, the thermal environment also behaves like an unblinking field of witnessed exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the surface جَحِيمًا still denotes blaze and the closing combat reference concerns another setting, but the focus branch of battle or death at a blaze and the packet's explicit mutual combat image support a kinetic overlay. Downstream prose should qualify it as battlefield-like intensity inside the fire scene, not claim that the punishment is literally a battle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جَحِيمًا has a battle-or-death-at-a-blaze branch, and أَنكَالًا removes the captive's ability to answer force with force.

activation_trace.role: Battle or death reaching a blaze supplies kinetic lethal intensity rather than static heat alone.
The shackle removes maneuver and defense, making the battlefield-like force radically one-sided.
Mutual fighting between parties supplies the explicit combat image that activates the focus branch by contrast.

changed_reading.before: The captive is held beside a stationary furnace.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, the blaze has battlefield-like lethal intensity while the shackles deny the captive every reciprocal defense.

strongest_changes: The deliberate respite of 73:11 turns لَدَيْنَا from bare location into controlled withholding of already available enforcement.
The choking food of 73:13 revises the pair into a multiscale anti-passage system spanning limbs, throat, deprivation, and environment.
The witness, disobedience, and severe seizure of 73:15-16 operationalize the exemplary branch of نكال as an auditable precedent.
The reminder, willing, and open path of 73:19 make the threat act in the present as deterrence before bodily punishment.
The measured ease, forgiveness, and mercy of 73:20 weaken an uncontrolled-anger account without canceling the controlled punitive reserve.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed static punishment nouns into mechanisms of controlled timing, reversed privilege, blocked passage, asymmetric motion, witnessed precedent, and present behavioral redirection. Most distinctive was the contrast between voluntary formative constraint early in the surah and imposed immobilization at the focus, followed by the late echo between لَدَيْنَا and what is advanced and found عِندَ اللَّهِ.
remaining_uncertainties: The chosen-versus-imposed constraint contrast is structurally strong but remains a reader-supplied relation rather than an explicit equation.
The scope of هَذِهِ in 73:19 may be the whole revelation rather than the immediately preceding punishment sequence.
The reserve-and-return model depends on a cross-ayah locative and recompense analogy and should remain exploratory.
The eye, anger, and battle branches of ج ح م are best carried as qualified overlays because the focus construction strongly privileges literal blaze.
